# Veritio

> Veritio is a protocol-first, open-source evidence layer for application audit
> trails: hash-chained events, AI-agent session capture, deterministic risk
> scoring, and signed export bundles (vevb-1) that anyone can verify offline.
> Veritio Cloud is the optional managed service on the same open protocol.
> Veritio supports compliance evidence; it does not make an organization
> compliant and is not legal advice.

Key facts: every event is locked into a gapless, hash-chained per-tenant
sequence; the TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs implement one language-neutral
protocol with byte-identical hashing and risk scores; export bundles verify
offline without a Veritio account; tenant data lives in the region chosen at
signup (EU jurisdiction, US, or APAC). Veritio Cloud plans: Pro $29/mo,
Team $99/mo, Compliance $499/mo, Enterprise custom — self-hosting the
open-source stack is free.

## Documentation

- [Documentation hub](https://getveritio.com/docs/): Cloud onboarding, agent capture, SDKs, self-hosting, pricing
- [Cloud getting started](https://getveritio.com/docs/cloud-getting-started/): sign-up, region choice, API keys, first events, verifiable export
- [Connect Claude Code & Codex](https://getveritio.com/docs/connect-agents/): tamper-evident audit trail for AI coding sessions, hosted MCP to query it back

## Product

- [Veritio Cloud](https://getveritio.com/cloud/): the hosted evidence layer — managed ingest, regional storage, signed exports
- [Pricing](https://getveritio.com/pricing/): plan rate table, allowances, overage, and what ships on every plan
- [Examples](https://getveritio.com/examples/): copy-pasteable SDK examples, no hosted account required

## Open source

- [GitHub — getveritio](https://github.com/getveritio): protocol spec, SDKs, storage conformance, verifier
